bearing.model.v1alpha1.Support.schema.js.description:
Support is one support version: one source's state for a fact over one
 maximal valid-time interval, as recorded over one record-time interval.

^(confidencePpm)$.description: Always present in outputs; 0 is explicit.

^(lastConfirmedAt)$.description: Informational: the latest confirming claim's observed_at.

^(retractedAt)$.description: When an apply replaced it; absent while current.

^(validFrom)$.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

^(validTo)$.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

adapter.description: Adapter name and version, e.g. "github@0.2.0". Empty for derived supports.

confidence_ppm.description: Always present in outputs; 0 is explicit.

evidence.description: Where a person can check it.

last_confirmed_at.description: Informational: the latest confirming claim's observed_at.

qualifiers.description: De-duplicated qualifier objects, sorted by JCS bytes.

retracted_at.description: When an apply replaced it; absent while current.

source.description: The configured source, "manual" or a "core/..." source.

valid_from.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

valid_to.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

via.description: The aliases the claim was resolved through.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Support.schema.js.title: Support

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Via.schema.json.description: Via is the aliases a claim's ends were resolved through.

subject.description: The aliases the observation's entity carried.

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.OrderingKey.sc.description:
OrderingKey is the key every write is compared by, left to right:
 (observed_at, observation_id, event_id, content_hash)
 (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Ordering and idempotency"). The strings compare
 by their UTF-8 bytes; pkg/model compares keys.

^(contentHash)$.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of the observation's data; for a
 manual event, of the payload.

^(eventId)$.description: The event that carried it, which includes the source.

^(observationId)$.description: The observation that made the write; for a manual event, the event ID.

content_hash.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of the observation's data; for a
 manual event, of the payload.

event_id.description: The event that carried it, which includes the source.

observation_id.description: The observation that made the write; for a manual event, the event ID.

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.OrderingKey.sc.title: Ordering Key

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.SupportSegment.description:
SupportSegment is one source's state for one fact over one valid-time
 interval, with the key of the write that decided it. A series of segments
 is what remains of all the source's writes about the fact: at each valid
 time the covering write with the greatest key.

^(validFrom)$.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

^(validTo)$.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

key.description:
The deciding write's ordering key; for a segment that joins
 confirmations, the last one's.

live.description:
True if the segment is asserted. An ended segment is kept so an older
 write applied later can't override it.

reason.description:
Ended segments: ASSERT for a claim's own valid_to, END for an absent
 claim, SNAPSHOT for a scope's watermark, DELETED for entity.deleted,
 WITHDRAWN for a withdrawn claim.
reason.title: Support Reason

support.description:
Live segments: the version's content, without its interval, fact_id and
 record times. For a segment that joins confirmations it is the first
 one's, so the first confirmation's key is the support's own
 observed_at, observation_id and event_id (without a content hash).

valid_from.description: Start of valid time; absent means unbounded.

valid_to.description: End of valid time; absent means unbounded.

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.SupportSegment.title: Support Segment
